import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv('data/dogs_zurich.csv')

# Get top 10 dog breeds by count
breed_counts = df['Rasse1Text'].dropna().value_counts().sort_values(ascending=False).head(10)

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))
sns.barplot(x=breed_counts.values, y=breed_counts.index, palette='viridis')
plt.xlabel('Number of Dogs')
plt.ylabel('Breed')
plt.title('Top 10 Dog Breeds in Zurich (by Registration Count)')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
